subject: session, variable: add privilege check to `set session_states` (#59601)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in `pkg/session/session.go` and `pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go`: `rs-group` (ResourceGroupName) is now handled in session-level Encode/Decode, and Decode applies a strict-mode-gated dynamic privilege check (RESOURCE_GROUP_ADMIN/USER) before changing the session’s resource group; `SessionVars.Encode/DecodeSessionStates` no longer directly encodes/decodes ResourceGroupName to avoid circular deps. Semantics align with existing resource-control strict-mode privilege patterns and remain present in upstream/master; no Blocker/High issues found in the scoped areas.
